name: A Volatile Marriage
source:
Felicia and Felix have loved each other fiercely since their college days, weathering every storm together. But when they move to a new city for a fresh start, their marriage is put to the ultimate test.

A cruel financial scam drains their savings, forcing them into grueling work schedules that leave them exhausted and distant.

As stress and resentment grow, old wounds reopen. Fake friends whisper doubts, and past lovers reappear, offering comfort in their loneliness. Temptation lingers, and the absence of emotional connection threatens to tear them apart.

Will they fight to rebuild what they’ve lost, or will the weight of betrayal and distrust destroy everything they’ve built? Their love is real—but is it enough?
